services_heading: Professional Painting & Decorating Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: From interior room makeovers to exterior weatherproofing, we handle residential and commercial painting with meticulous attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Transform your living spaces with high-quality emulsion and specialist finishes. We prepare walls thoroughly, protect your furniture, and leave no mess behind.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior finishes that protect and refresh your home's appearance. We use premium paints designed to withstand the British climate.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Create focal points in any room with bold colours and designer finishes. Our colour consultation helps you choose palettes that suit your style.

services.title: Woodwork & Skirting
services.desc: Professional preparation and finishing of skirting boards, doors, window frames and other timber. We sand, prime and apply durable, smooth finishes.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Office refurbishment and shop fitting work completed on schedule and within budget. Minimal disruption to your business during working hours.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Expert hanging of standard and specialist papers, textures and murals. Perfect pattern matching and clean, long-lasting application.

about_pullquote: I take pride in every brush stroke and leave your home better than I found it.
about_para_1: Painto has been painting and decorating homes across Leicester for over a decade. What began as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted local business built on honest workmanship and fair pricing. We've completed over 500 projects — from cosy terraces to substantial family homes — and we're still driven by the same principle: do the job properly the first time.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we show up on time, communicate clearly, and protect your home as if it were our own. We don't cut corners on preparation or use cheap materials. Every project gets the same care, whether it's a single bedroom or a whole house renovation.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Painto

reviews.text: Had Painto in to decorate our lounge and hallway. Brilliant attention to detail — moved all the furniture carefully, protected everything, and left the place spotless. The finish is immaculate. Will definitely call them again for the bedrooms.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Needed our front door and windows done before winter. Marco came out quickly for a quote, was very reasonable, and completed the work in two days. Weather-tight and looks fantastic. Top bloke, would recommend to anyone.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Repainted three bedrooms and the landing. Painto's team were professional, punctual and tidy. Colour advice was spot-on and they worked around our family without fuss. Best tradesman we've used in years.
reviews.author: Sarah M.
